findings.evidence: "The requester gets an automatic reminder after three days."
findings.fix: Specify the trigger: "The requester gets an automatic reminder three days after the request is marked incomplete."
findings.violation: The reference point for the three-day period is ambiguous. It's unclear whether this means three days from initial submission, three days after the request becomes incomplete, or some other trigger.

findings.evidence: "Employees keep proof of purchase for every stipend item. A photo of the receipt is enough for most requests. Additionally, employees shall retain receipts for one year after the purchase date."
findings.fix: Clarify: "For initial processing, a photo of the receipt is acceptable. However, employees must retain the original receipts for one year after the purchase date."
findings.location: Required Documentation section, first and second paragraphs
findings.violation: The relationship between these requirements is unclear - it's ambiguous whether "keeping proof of purchase" and "retaining receipts" are the same requirement stated twice or two separate requirements with different timelines.

findings.evidence: "The applicant must keep the equipment in good working condition and this office may ask for a brief photo check once a year."
findings.fix: Replace "this office" with the actual office name: "The applicant must keep the equipment in good working condition and the benefits team may ask for a brief photo check once a year."
findings.location: Restrictions and Exceptions section, first paragraph
findings.violation: "This office" does not specify which office (benefits team, finance office, people operations, etc.) will request the photo check.

findings.evidence: "Similarly, the policy applies to one device per category per employee whenever the benefits team confirms that the role genuinely requires a second device because fieldwork regularly takes the employee away from the single fixed desk that the standard equipment list assumes every applicant has for the whole benefit year while the finance office tracks the second device against the same annual amount that the equipment catalog publishes for each category."
findings.fix: Break into multiple shorter sentences: "The policy allows one second device per category if the benefits team confirms the role requires it due to regular fieldwork. The finance office will track the second device against the per-category annual amount published in the equipment catalog."
findings.location: Restrictions and Exceptions section, second paragraph
findings.violation: This sentence is so long and structurally convoluted (with nested clauses linked by "because" and "while") that the actual policy rule is difficult to parse.

findings.evidence: "You record the stipend item on the request form. Finance reconciles the stipend item against the request log each month. Payroll releases the stipend item amount after that monthly review."
findings.fix: Add a definition at the start of the section: "A 'stipend item' refers to the specific equipment or category requested on the reimbursement form."
findings.violation: The term "stipend item" is used repeatedly but is never defined, leaving unclear whether it refers to the equipment, the request, the monetary amount, or something else.

findings.evidence: "You record the stipend item on the request form... Finance reconciles... Payroll releases... Also, you submit the request in the portal."
findings.fix: Maintain consistent perspective throughout, either all second person or all third person.
findings.location: Terminology Notes section, first and second paragraphs
findings.violation: The section inconsistently switches between directly addressing the employee in second person ("You") and referring to departments in third person ("Finance," "Payroll"), creating confusion about perspective and responsibility.

findings.evidence: "Completing the request begins with confirming eligibility, and uploading the receipt."
findings.fix: Complete the list: "Completing the request involves the following steps: 1) Confirming eligibility, 2) Uploading the receipt, 3) [additional steps]" or remove "begins with" and clarify this is the only step.
findings.violation: The section title is plural ("Request Steps") and the phrase "begins with" suggests multiple sequential steps, but only one partial step is listed, leaving the process incomplete.

findings.evidence: Program Overview: "The benefits team tracks the stipend budget at the start of the fiscal year." Special Cases: "The finance liaison reviews the stipend budget at the start of the fiscal year." Questions and Updates: "The people operations office tracks the stipend budget at the start of the fiscal year."
findings.fix: Identify and retain only the correct office responsible for budget tracking, removing the other two contradictory statements, or clarify the distinct roles each office plays if all three are legitimately involved.
findings.location: Program Overview, Special Cases, and Questions and Updates sections
findings.violation: Three different offices are described as performing the same budget-tracking task, creating contradictory information about which office actually holds this responsibility.
